subject: general
question: The students of a class are standing in a row. Manoj is 10th from the start of the row and Anoop is 35th from the end of the row. Sonu is 10 places ahead of Anoop. If 15 students are standing between Manoj and Sonu, then how many students are there in the class in total?
solution:
Given:

Position of Manoj from the start = 10th

Position of Anoop from the end = 35th

Sonu is 10 places ahead of Anoop,

so Sonu's position from the end = Position of Anoop from the end + Sonu is 10 places ahead

= 35 + 10 = 45th</p&g
